title: Carry-In Charges for Attached Dwellings on Homeowner Service Contracts Replacements
content:
**Delivery term.** On a replacement Bridgewell authorizes on a Homeowner Service Contract after a stalled repair, a carry-in charge pays for carrying the replacement into an attached dwelling. The dwelling type is the property type recorded on the contract.

| Property type | Item replaced | Carry-in charge |
|---|---|---|
| townhome or condominium | refrigerator, clothes washer or clothes dryer | 60.00 |
| townhome or condominium | any other item | 25.00 |
| single-family home or mobile home | any item | nothing |

The carry-in charge is added to the stalled-repair replacement cost as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, and the cost so obtained is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits without being rounded first.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- Condominium, clothes dryer replaced: 60.00.
- Townhome, water heater replaced: 25.00.
- Mobile home, refrigerator replaced: nothing.
